title: PostReady: PR #540 — Tidy Create Video form — merge helpers, rail photos, collapse direction
description: Cleaned up the Create Video form: merged helper text into labels, added rail photo thumbnails for visual reference, and collapsed the direction field to reduce visual noise.

title: PostReady: PR #541 — Fix: Add scene divider from dangling when row wraps
description: Fixed a layout bug where the Add scene divider element would dangle incorrectly when the scene row wrapped to a new line.

title: PostReady: PR #542 — Tidy Batch tab — compact per-prompt refs, align columns
description: Tidied the Batch tab UI: compacted per-prompt reference display and aligned columns for a cleaner, more readable batch queue layout.

title: PostReady: PR #543 — Drop 'We email you when done' pill from Batch tab
description: Removed the 'We email you when done' informational pill from the Batch tab to reduce clutter and simplify the batch run UI.

title: PostReady: PR #544 — Per-prompt 'Text on the image' for Batch
description: Added per-prompt 'Text on the image' option to Batch mode, allowing each prompt in a batch to specify its own image text overlay independently.

title: PostReady: PR #545 — Line up the prompt card with the run panel on Batch
description: Fixed Batch tab layout so the prompt card aligns correctly with the run panel.

title: PostReady: PR #546 — Stack the Create Post preview so it fits the result rail
description: Stacked the Create Post preview layout so the generated result fits cleanly within the result rail on all viewports.

title: PostReady: PR #547 — Expand the Create Post preview once an image exists
description: The Create Post preview panel now expands automatically once a generated image is present, surfacing the result more prominently in the result rail.

title: PostReady: PR #548 — Stop AI images rendering garbled signs, logos and brand badges
description: Tightened Pro Prompt and image no-branding guard to eliminate garbled landmark signs, fake brand badges, and doubled text. Evoke famous places by light and skyline only; ban readable text, logos, badges, and signs in prompts. Prompt-only fix.

title: PostReady: PR #549 — Rewrite Pro Prompt as a Seedream-tuned visual-spec compiler (Phase 1)
description: Rewrote Pro Prompt's image-side to match Seedream 4.5 prompting style: concise, front-loaded (subject + action first), explicit object counts, positive geometry contracts per domain, one light source, quoted exact text only when wanted, and one short scene-specific restriction instead of long negative lists.
